text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate + latency spike on /v1/generate for model-family:redwood-v1 (region:us-west-2) — 6xx rate 18% (baseline 0.2%), p95 latency 4.2s (SLO 1.2s). Pager: @maria-g.

maria-g: oncall ack. looking now, pulling recent deploys and metrics.

raj: I saw a handful of anomalies in kv-cache eviction logs earlier, could be related. tagging @sasha for quant/ffx insight.

sasha: thx. i can look at quant paths. quick q: is this only affecting redwood-v1 or also redwood-lite variants?

maria-g: initial routing shows traffic split: 80% redwood-v1, 20% redwood-lite. errors are concentrated on v1.

jordan: I can flip runtime diagnostics to verbose for affected instances, but that may increase load. propose capturing 30s then revert.

maria-g: go for it. also start mitigation plan: 1) disable KV cache for v1 route, 2) reduce max_batch_size from 32->8 for impacted fleet, 3) route new requests to redwood-lite as fallback for critical customers.

raj: running command to disable kv cache on fleet group rg-124:
```bash
redwoodctl route update --route redwood-v1 --set kv_cache.enabled=false --scope rg-124 --reason "live mitigation - kv cache suspected"
```

raj: command succeeded, patch rolled to 6/8 instances. monitoring.

incident-bot: NOTE: Route update event logged (audit-id: evt-20240316-01).

sasha: while kv cache off, quantized kernels may change perf characteristics. watch for token cost spike and latency.

maria-g: shifting 30% of incoming traffic to redwood-lite fallback via policy rule:
```json
{"policy":"fallback","from":"redwood-v1","to":"redwood-lite","pct":30}
```
(rolled)

jordan: verbose logs captured for 45s. seeing repeated stack traces from kvcache manager: OOM on cache shard 3 followed by tokenization retries, and then the runtime hitting a fallback code path that retries with full context leading to latency amplification.

maria-g: sounds like cache eviction + retry storm. good that fallback is live. any customer impact numbers?

raj: brief count: ~12 enterprise customers had increased error rates, 3 of them above threshold for degraded experience; CS alerted and we created support ticket SUP-8462.

sasha: I found a regression in the quant path where a recent kernel change didn't handle evicted KV prefills correctly for int8 fallback — that explains decoding errors followed by 6xx in some pipelines. making a patch now.

maria-g: can you test patch in staging and provide a canary build? we want minimal disruption.

sasha: will build canary image q-fix-20240316 and push to canary group.

jordan: also reduced max_batch_size on remaining instances; p95 dropped to 1.4s and 6xx rate to 2.1% — still above baseline but trending down.

maria-g: good. timeline for full remediation?

sasha: canary passed synthetics for 10 minutes, no decoding errors. planning rollout to remaining instances in 3 batches with health checks. estimated 25m.

incident-bot: STATUS CHANGE: incident severity reduced to S2.

raj: rolling patch to batch 2 now.

maria-g: heads-up to infra: if patch fails, rollback plan is to re-enable kv cache and scale up instances temporarily. please be ready for capacity ops. @oncall-rotation-bot assign infra on-call.

oncall-rotation-bot: infra on-call assigned: @jordan.

jordan: standing by. rollback step validated: `redwoodctl route update --route redwood-v1 --set kv_cache.enabled=true --scope rg-124`

raj: batch 3 applied, all instances healthy. latency p95 at 0.95s, 6xx at 0.4% now.

maria-g: excellent. logging postmortem follow-up items now. I will coordinate with product & CS for customer comms.

maria-g: ACTIONS (initial):
- sasha: root cause patch for quantified int8 kernel (JIRA: INF-1629).
- raj: post-incident rollout playbook update to include automatic kv-cache throttling when eviction > 5% (JIRA: INF-1631).
- jordan: add capacity playbook for rapid scale-up during kv-cache storms (JIRA: INF-1632).
- maria-g: schedule postmortem meeting and send invites to eng-runtime, eng-sre, product ops, cs.

sasha: noted. I'll include diagnostic asserts and a regression test for prefilling evicted KV shards.

raj: I'll add an alert rule to detect correlated p95 + kv eviction events:
```yaml
alert: KVCacheEvictionStorm
expr: increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]) > 100 and histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 2
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```

maria-g: perfect. timeline for formal postmortem? we should hold within 48 hours while memory is fresh.

sasha: available tomorrow 10:00-12:00.

raj: I can do 14:00-16:00.

jordan: 11:00-13:00 works for me.

maria-g: scheduling at 11:00 to capture majority; invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, cs, security. I've created postmortem draft doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/INF-1629-postmortem (CS will add affected customers list).

incident-bot: Meeting scheduled: Postmortem - INF-1629, 2024-03-17 11:00 PST.

maria-g: for remediation tracking, i'll create a tracking checklist in the ticket and assign owners. please add estimates for ETA.

sasha: estimate for code patch merge + canary rollout + regression tests: 2 days. assign to sasha.

raj: playbook updates ETA: 1 day. assign to raj.

jordan: capacity playbook and runbook tests ETA: 3 days. assign to jordan.

maria-g: follow-ups outside immediate scope: add golden-path load test for KV eviction scenarios and add a canary that toggles kv_cache off in a small % of traffic regularly to detect regressions. file as INF-1635, owner: eng-runtime.

sasha: another item: make quantization rollouts require integration test gate that verifies KV prefill and decode path for int8. adding as INF-1636.

raj: linking support ticket SUP-8462 to incident, CS drafting customer comms, tagging impacted enterprise customers for remediation credits if needed.

maria-g: final notes for calendar: I'll post a short incident summary in #incidents channel after postmortem. keep this thread for remediation updates.

sasha: pushed final fix to main and kicked off CI. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4723

raj: playbook PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/209

jordan: capacity runbook PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/pulls/88 — includes test checklist.

maria-g: closing immediate pager. If anyone observes regression re-open the page or ping me directly. great work everyone. :tada:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause identified as quantized kernel regression causing KV-prefill decode errors + eviction-induced retry storm. Severity downgraded. Postmortem scheduled.

maria-g: POSTMORTEM ACTION STATUS (to update here after meeting):
- INF-1629: sasha: in progress (ETA 2d)
- INF-1631: raj: in review (ETA 1d)
- INF-1632: jordan: todo (ETA 3d)
- INF-1635: eng-runtime: todo (ETA 1w)
- INF-1636: sasha: todo (ETA 4d)

sasha: I'll post CI results in this thread when green.

raj: adding unit tests to alerting and will post coordinates once deployed.

jordan: doing a small post-deploy load test now to confirm stability for next 2 hours. will report back.

maria-g: thanks all. leaving annotated timeline in INF-1629 doc and closing this oncall thread.

jordan: quick update: 2h smoke test green, no spikes.

sasha: CI green and regression tests pass. PR merged.

raj: playbook updates merged.

maria-g: marking items as resolved as they complete and will follow up in postmortem doc. thread closed.
